
```{r}
library(tidyverse)

# LOAD RAW FILES
# Adjust paths as needed
counts_raw <- read_csv("counts.csv")       # wide gene-count matrix
de_raw     <- read_csv("de_results.csv")   # differential expression results
```

```{r}
# SAMPLE KEY
# CG01-03 = a3c | CG04-06 = a3d | CG07-09 = a4c | CG10-12 = a4d
samples <- tibble(
  sample_id     = sprintf("CG%02d", 1:12),
  condition     = rep(c("a3c", "a3d", "a4c", "a4d"), each = 3),
  apoE_genotype = rep(c("e3/e3", "e3/e3", "e4/e4", "e4/e4"), each = 3),
  exon_status   = rep(c("ex19", "Dex19", "ex19", "Dex19"), each = 3)
)
 
write_csv(samples, "samples.csv")
message("✓ samples.csv written (", nrow(samples), " rows)")
```


```{r}
# GENES TABLE
genes <- de_raw %>%
  select(gene_id, gene_name, gene_type, mgi_id, havana_gene) %>%
  distinct(gene_id, .keep_all = TRUE)

write_csv(genes, "genes.csv")
message("✓ genes.csv written (", nrow(genes), " rows)")
```

```{r}
# EXPRESSION COUNTS TABLE  (wide → long)
# The counts file has columns: geneID, CG01, CG02, ..., CG12
expression_counts <- counts_raw %>%
  rename(gene_id = geneID) %>%   # normalize column name
  pivot_longer(
    cols      = starts_with("CG"),
    names_to  = "sample_id",
    values_to = "count"
  ) %>%
  # This will now match versioned IDs correctly
  semi_join(genes, by = "gene_id") %>%
  select(gene_id, sample_id, count)

write_csv(expression_counts, "expression_counts.csv")
message("✓ expression_counts.csv written (", nrow(expression_counts), " rows)")
```

```{r}
# DIFFERENTIAL EXPRESSION TABLE
differential_expression <- de_raw %>%
  select(
    gene_id,
    comparison_group,
    logFC,
    logCPM,
    F,
    PValue,
    FDR
  )

write_csv(differential_expression, "differential_expression.csv")
message("✓ differential_expression.csv written (", nrow(differential_expression), " rows)")
```

```{r}
# COMPARISONS TABLE
# Derive condition_1 / condition_2 by splitting on "_"
# e.g. "a3c_a3d" → condition_1 = "a3c", condition_2 = "a3d"
comparisons <- differential_expression %>%
  distinct(comparison_group) %>%
  separate(comparison_group,
           into  = c("condition_1", "condition_2"),
           sep   = "_",
           remove = FALSE)
 
write_csv(comparisons, "comparisons.csv")
message("✓ comparisons.csv written (", nrow(comparisons), " rows)")

# Do all DE gene_ids exist in genes?
anti_join(differential_expression, genes, by = "gene_id")

# Do all DE comparison_groups exist in comparisons?
anti_join(differential_expression, comparisons, by = "comparison_group")

# Do all expression_counts gene_ids exist in genes?
anti_join(expression_counts, genes, by = "gene_id")
```

```{r}
# QUICK VALIDATION
cat("\n--- Validation summary ---\n")
 
# All sample_ids in expression_counts exist in samples
orphan_samples <- anti_join(expression_counts, samples, by = "sample_id")
cat("expression_counts rows with unknown sample_id: ", nrow(orphan_samples), "\n")
 
# All gene_ids in expression_counts exist in genes
orphan_genes_ec <- anti_join(expression_counts, genes, by = "gene_id")
cat("expression_counts rows with unknown gene_id:   ", nrow(orphan_genes_ec), "\n")
 
# All gene_ids in differential_expression exist in genes
orphan_genes_de <- anti_join(differential_expression, genes, by = "gene_id")
cat("differential_expression rows with unknown gene_id: ", nrow(orphan_genes_de), "\n")
 
# All comparison_groups in differential_expression exist in comparisons
orphan_cg <- anti_join(differential_expression, comparisons, by = "comparison_group")
cat("differential_expression rows with unknown comparison_group: ", nrow(orphan_cg), "\n")
 
cat("\nAll five CSVs are ready to LOAD DATA INFILE into MariaDB.\n")
cat("Recommended load order (respects FK dependencies):\n")
cat("  1. genes.csv\n  2. samples.csv\n  3. comparisons.csv\n")
cat("  4. expression_counts.csv\n  5. differential_expression.csv\n")
```
